# USMLE Courses EU

> Kaplan's official USMLE preparation platform offering comprehensive courses for Steps 1, 2 CK, and 3 with live online, on-demand, and in-person options globally.

USMLE Courses EU is the European gateway to Kaplan Medical's comprehensive United States Medical Licensure Exam preparation programs. The site serves international medical graduates and US-based students seeking to pass USMLE exams and pursue medical careers in the United States, offering flexible learning formats including live lectures, on-demand courses, and practice tools like Qbank.

## Key Topics

- USMLE (United States Medical Licensing Exam)
- Kaplan Medical
- USMLE Step 1
- USMLE Step 2 CK
- USMLE Step 3
- Qbank (practice tool)
- International Medical Graduates (IMGs)
- Medical licensure
- Exam preparation
- Live online courses
- On-demand courses
- Clinical knowledge
- ECFMG certification
- Residency matching
- Medical Education CZ

## USMLE Courses & Programs

- [USMLE Preparation courses in USA and online](https://www.usmle-courses.eu/usmle-preparation-courses-in-usa): Main product page for Kaplan USMLE preparation courses with pricing options
- [USMLE Step 1 Courses](https://www.usmle-courses.eu/about-our-usmle-step-1-courses): Detailed guide to USMLE Step 1 courses, exam format, and basic sciences content
- [USMLE Step 2 CK Courses](https://www.usmle-courses.eu/about-our-usmle-step-2-ck-courses): USMLE Step 2 CK course guide covering clinical knowledge exam preparation
- [USMLE Step 3 Courses](https://www.usmle-courses.eu/about-our-step-3-courses): USMLE Step 3 course overview with clinical simulations and patient management
- [Kaplan USMLE Live Online and On Demand prep](https://www.usmle-courses.eu/usmle-live-online-and-on-demand-courses): Kaplan Live Online and on-demand course options for USMLE Step 1 preparation
- [USMLE Step 1 LIVE lectures in India](https://www.usmle-courses.eu/toefl): USMLE Step 1 and TOEFL iBT prep courses available in India with live lectures

## Pricing, Schedules & Registration

- [Kaplan USMLE Courses Schedule and Tuitions](https://www.usmle-courses.eu/usmle-courses-schedule-tuitions): Course schedules, pricing, and tuition information for all USMLE steps
- [Register for Kaplan USMLE courses](https://www.usmle-courses.eu/registration): Course registration and enrollment form for Kaplan USMLE preparation programs
- [USMLE Courses Application information](https://www.usmle-courses.eu/application-information): Enrollment and application process guide for USMLE courses and visa documentation

## Practice Tools & Resources

- [Try Kaplan's Qbank](https://www.usmle-courses.eu/qbank): Kaplan Qbank practice tool with enhanced explanations for Steps 1, 2 CK, & 3

## USMLE & Medical Licensure Guides

- [The USMLE® Exams](https://www.usmle-courses.eu/the-usmle-exams): Overview and guide to all USMLE exam steps and requirements for US medical licensure
- [Requirements for become a licensed doctor in USA](https://www.usmle-courses.eu/united-states-medical-licensure-requirements): Medical licensure requirements for IMGs including ECFMG certification pathway
- [Career in medicine](https://www.usmle-courses.eu/residency-match): Guide to USMLE exams, residency matching, and medical career progression for IMGs
